misprints.note: No circumflex printed on the final syllable (end of the Soldatgöromål entry, at the top of the strip).
In the Snöre entry, the acute is printed on the iota.
In 'κατακλίνεσθαι ὥς καθεύδοντα', the ω seems to carry a rough breathing plus an acute.

uncertain.note: The mark over the ω is small. It may be a plain rough breathing (ὡς) rather than rough breathing plus acute.
The genitive ending is printed with no accent, as is usual for endings. The old OCR read ὠνος, but the scan shows no breathing.
The mark over the iota looks like an acute, not a smooth breathing, in both σειρίς and στηθοδεσμίς.
The dot of the i in 'Solk, -a, -ig' is missing (broken type). Read as i.
